causal_contract.definition: FutureSeed on/off constructors use byte-identical initial parameters. The functional check loads the same accepted step-500 FutureSeed checkpoint into both arms; only future_seed_scale changes recurrent initial-state injection.

decision.explanation: FutureSeed improves 46-50-blank full-board exact by at least 10 points on 4 causal carriers (rwkv, gdn, gdn2, kda). The cross-carrier causal gate passes.
decision.success_threshold: at least two carriers with b46-50 loop5 exact delta >= +0.10
